rules.description: Matches law firm names ending in 'Rechtsanwälte KG' or 'Rechtsanwalts KG', handling 'u.', '&' and complex names, using positive context anchors.

rules.name: Law Firm GmbH & Co KG Names
rules.description: Matches law firm names ending in 'Rechtsanwälte GmbH & Co KG' or 'Rechtsanwalts GmbH & Co KG', using positive context anchors.

rules.name: Law Firm GesbR Names
rules.description: Matches law firm names ending in 'Rechtsanwälte GesbR' or 'Rechtsanwalts GesbR', capturing the full preceding name sequence.

rules.name: Law Firm GbR Names
rules.description: Matches law firm names ending in 'Rechtsanwälte GbR' or 'Rechtsanwalts GbR', capturing the full preceding name sequence.

rules.name: AG Company Names Refined
rules.description: Matches company names ending in 'AG', 'Aktiengesellschaft', or 'GmbH & Co KG' (if AG is part of the suffix) with a strict proper noun prefix, using positive context anchors.

rules.name: Limited Company Names
rules.description: Matches company names ending in 'Limited' (e.g., 'Lacks Bildung Limited'), which were missed by GmbH/AG patterns.
